Noble Materiality

Curated timber
& living stone.

Every piece originates from ethically harvested hardwoods and natural quarried stones, selected for striking grain pattern, tactile depth, and longevity.

Hardwood · Sustainable

American Black Walnut

Deep chocolate hues with undulating cathedral grain. Hand-burnished with natural matte organic oils for a silky tactile surface.

Living Stone · Italy

Honed Roman Travertine

Architectural porous stone with warm beige striations and subtle earthy cavities. Sealed with a matte finish that preserves its organic texture.

Artisanal Fiber · Organic

Natural Woven Cane

Sustainably harvested rattan woven by hand in intricate octagonal patterns, providing both breathable lightness and flexible ergonomic support.

Hardwood · Smoked Finish

Smoked Architectural Oak

Fumed with natural ammonia vapor to darken the timber through its core without pigments, emphasizing deep wire-brushed medullary rays.

Textile · Belgium

Belgian Bouclé & Linen

Textured tactile upholstery spun from pure wool and linen loops. Inherently durable, pill-resistant, and extraordinarily soft to touch.

Metal · Unlacquered

Living Patina Brass

Solid unlacquered brass joinery accents and leg caps, hand-brushed to develop an exquisite aged patina unique to your home environment.

The Atelier

Designed to be
remembered.

Atelier Interiors creates sculptural sofas, bespoke beds, architectural dining furniture and handcrafted seating.

Every piece honors natural timber grain, master mortise and tenon joinery, and sculptural comfort. Custom orders invite each client and interior architect to shape the proportions around their private residence.
